meta.unit: cmd/reconcile + internal/store reconcile/invariants layer — W1's acceptance-evidence harness: the bridge arithmetic, the sampling partition, the as-of predicate, the invariant scan SQL, the RPC classifier, the rewind re-check, the golden Row A live-read law, the DSN tripwire, the schema gate, the tolerance-laundering guard, and the F1 aggregate-weld census (risk-quant amendment).
meta.purpose: Wave-10 brief §10's twelve named mutation targets plus the verification bar's named extras (tripwire, schema gate, strata partition, as-of sum boundary, tolerance arms, invariant scans) plus the risk-quant amendment's named F1 kill. Run through the committed applier .superpowers/sdd/wave16-mutations/mutate.py: exactly-one-occurrence asserted per edit, byte-level in-memory restores verified byte-identical, git status clean after the loop.
design_notes: NEW FILES ARE LF IN THE WORKING TREE (written this wave, not yet re-checked-out), so patterns embed \n — the CRLF trap the applier exists to catch does not apply to them; the applier's exactly-once assertion still guards every edit.

DB-GATED KILLS: mutants in internal/store SQL are killed by tests that need TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at the scratch database solvent_test (NEVER solvent — the falsifiability helper refuses that name). The loop shell exports it; the applier inherits env.
SOLVENT_LIVE_RPC_TESTS stays UNSET: no live endpoints in mutation loops; every cmd/reconcile kill runs against in-process fakes that can fail (pruned rejections, 429 storms, wrong-height chunks).
EVERY KILL IS BEHAVIORAL: each mutant makes a named test assert the exact property the brief states, not a coverage count.

mutations.description: bridge floor→ceil (brief target 1): mulDivFloor becomes mulDivCeil
mutations.property: the §3.3 bridge is EXACTLY the contract's floor (DebtManagerStorageContract.sol:520-522) — a ceil manufactures 1-wei USD drift on every remainder-bearing row; killed by TestMulDivFloorBridge's n=1, I=1e18+1 case (floor 1, ceil 2) and the recon validation triple

edits.search:
out := new(big.Int).Mul(n, index)
	return out.Quo(out, wad)

mutations.description: migration_genesis dropped from the as-of sum predicate (brief target 2)
mutations.property: as-of sums include EVERY delta-bearing event type, migration_genesis above all — the majority of DM debt genesis enters derived state only through those rows; killed by TestAsOfEventSumsIncludesMigrationGenesisAndBoundary (sum 1050 becomes 50 under the mutant)

edits.search:
AND block_number <= $3 AND delta IS NOT NULL
		 GROUP BY account, asset, side
edits.replace:
AND block_number <= $3 AND delta IS NOT NULL AND event_type <> 'migration_genesis'
		 GROUP BY account, asset, side

mutations.description: as-of boundary <= → < (verification-bar target 'as-of sum boundary')
mutations.property: the boundary is INCLUSIVE: ApplyDerived commits events THROUGH the cursor block atomically with it, so an event AT P is part of the pinned state; killed by TestAsOfEventSumsIncludesMigrationGenesisAndBoundary's boundary event at exactly P (1050 becomes 1000)

edits.search:
AND block_number <= $3 AND delta IS NOT NULL
		 GROUP BY account, asset, side
edits.replace:
AND block_number < $3 AND delta IS NOT NULL
		 GROUP BY account, asset, side

mutations.description: set-equality weakened to subset (brief target 3): the chain-only arm deleted
mutations.property: the token-set equality is BIDIRECTIONAL (§3.3): a chain token the DB never derived is a derivation miss — exactly the leg a subset check silently passes; killed by TestCompareDMRowZeroTrimSetEquality's derivation-miss case (SetEqual stays true under the mutant)

edits.replace:
// MUTANT W10M4: chain-only tokens no longer break set equality (subset check)
		_ = onChain

mutations.description: scan 2 IS DISTINCT FROM → = (brief target 4, arm 1)
mutations.property: scan 2's predicate selects DISAGREEMENTS; '=' selects agreements — the healthy matched pair becomes a violation row and every seeded orphan vanishes; killed by TestInvariantScan2EventSumFalsifiability (both the empty-pristine and seeded-violation assertions invert)

edits.search: WHERE ev.total IS DISTINCT FROM bal.amount
edits.replace: WHERE ev.total = bal.amount

mutations.description: scan 2 zero-sum allowance re-added (brief target 4, arm 2 — the L0-4 regression)
mutations.property: a zero-sum event group with a MISSING balance row is a REAL orphan (both live apply and the rewind rebuild always materialize amount-0 rows) — the allowance makes that class a fixture-that-cannot-fail; killed by TestInvariantScan2EventSumFalsifiability's violation class 1 (expected 1 row, mutant returns 0)

edits.search: WHERE ev.total IS DISTINCT FROM bal.amount
edits.replace:
WHERE ev.total IS DISTINCT FROM bal.amount
  AND NOT (ev.total = 0 AND bal.amount IS NULL)

mutations.description: scan 1 HAVING > 1 → >= 1 (brief target 5)
mutations.property: exactly one hash per height is the HEALTHY case; >= 1 flags every populated height; killed by TestInvariantScan1DistinctHashFalsifiability's pristine assertion (empty becomes 2 rows under the mutant)

edits.search: HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT block_hash) > 1
edits.replace: HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT block_hash) >= 1

mutations.description: scan 3 comparison inverted (brief target 6)
mutations.property: borrow_index is monotonic NON-DECREASING; the inverted predicate flags the healthy increase and misses the seeded regression; killed by TestInvariantScan3BorrowIndexFalsifiability on both arms

mutations.description: REQUIRE_DATA escalation removed — skip becomes the only empty-population outcome (brief target 7)
mutations.property: under SOLVENT_INVARIANT_REQUIRE_DATA=1 an empty population is a FAILURE, never a skip — the receipt command sets the variable precisely so the evidence run cannot vacuously pass against an empty or wrong database; killed by TestRequireDataVerdictEscalation

edits.replace:
_ = requireData // MUTANT W10M8: the escalation is gone — empty always skips
	return VerdictSkip

mutations.description: classifier misfiles state-pruned as transport-throttle (brief target 8)
mutations.property: state-pruned is the ARCHIVE-CAPABILITY verdict (exit 2 at a golden pin), never a backoff-and-retry class; killed by TestClassifierBucketTable + TestClassifierPrunedIsNeverThrottle + TestRunnerPrunedOnlyAfterFullBudget (the terminal class assertion flips to throttle)

edits.search: return classStatePruned
edits.replace: return classThrottle // MUTANT W10M9: pruned misfiled as retryable

mutations.description: residue classification without the fully_liquidated predicate (brief target 9)
mutations.property: the F2 hypothesis is scoped to FULLY-LIQUIDATED accounts: the silent zeroing mechanism (DebtManagerCore.sol:550-553) only fires there, so the same numeric shape on a live account is a DIFFERENT bug that must stay unclassified; killed by TestResidueShapedExactHypothesis's first case

mutations.description: rewind re-check trusts MAX(reorg_epochs.epoch) instead of acked_epoch (brief target 10)
mutations.property: PruneAckedReorgEpochs deletes acked epochs, so a rewind+ack+prune cycle mid-run leaves MAX unchanged while acked_epoch moved (RewindDerived always bumps it, acks are monotone) — the MAX-trusting detector is silent on exactly that hole; killed by TestRewindMovedIsPruneImmune

edits.search: if cur.AckedEpoch != baseline.AckedEpoch[e] {
edits.replace: if baseline.MaxEpoch[cur.ChainID] != baseline.MaxEpoch[cur.ChainID] { // MUTANT W10M11: trusts the prunable MAX signal

mutations.description: golden Row A replaced by fixture comparison (brief target 11)
mutations.property: Row A is the LITERAL W1 clause: a live pinned chain read at 25,584,990 — never a fixture substitute (constants never cross pins, L0-2); killed by TestGoldenRowAIsALiveChainReadAtTheW1Pin (Row A's chain leg stops being the live value) and TestGoldenRowAFailsWhenDBDisagreesWithTheLiveRead (the mutant PASSES a DB that merely matches the fixtures)

mutations.description: resolved seed not echoed into the artifact (brief target 12)
mutations.property: a run whose artifact does not carry the resolved seed is unreproducible — the default seed is the OP pin hash, which exists nowhere else; killed by TestArtifactEchoesResolvedSeed

edits.search: run["seed_resolved"] = seed
edits.replace: _ = seed // MUTANT W10M13: the seed is never echoed

mutations.description: DSN-identity tripwire disabled (verification-bar target 'tripwire')
mutations.property: identical test and live database identities MUST kill the run at Phase 0 (exit 2) — the destructive suite pointed at the live database is the single worst hazard this wave closes (L2-1); killed by TestDSNTripwireDetectsSameDatabase

mutations.description: schema gate exact-match weakened to >= (verification-bar target 'schema gate')
mutations.property: the gate is EXACT both directions: a database ahead of the binary may have reshaped the tables the compiled queries read; killed by TestSchemaGateIsExactBothDirections (got=9, expected=8 must refuse)

edits.search: return got == expected
edits.replace: return got >= expected // MUTANT W10M15: a future schema passes the gate

mutations.description: strata partition precedence inverted (verification-bar target 'strata partition')
mutations.property: the strata are a DISJOINT PRECEDENCE partition: liquidated beats migrated — an account with both histories belongs to the liquidated stratum (residue probes live there); killed by TestSampleDMBorrowersStrataPrecedenceAndDeterminism (the liq+mig account classifies migrated under the mutant)

edits.search:
CASE WHEN liquidated THEN 'liquidated'
            WHEN migrated  THEN 'migrated'
edits.replace:
CASE WHEN migrated THEN 'migrated'
            WHEN liquidated  THEN 'liquidated'

mutations.description: F1 aggregate weld computed over sampled accounts only (risk-quant amendment's NAMED mutation target)
mutations.property: the weld's derived side is the ALL-ACCOUNTS census — the sampling universe is position_events, so a never-derived borrower is structurally unselectable and ONLY the whole-table aggregate can catch phantom debt; the sampled aggregation exists solely as a coverage diagnostic; killed by TestComputeDMWeldInputsCoversAllAccounts (All shows 400 where the census says 1000)

mutations.property: ANY nonzero -tolerance-dm-wei forces result=fail-with-tolerance structurally — a tolerance can never launder into a pass receipt, even with zero gated failures (§3.5); killed by TestNonzeroToleranceCannotProducePass

edits.replace: _ = toleranceDMWei // MUTANT W10M18: tolerance no longer forces fail-with-tolerance
